comment_text: Finally, well deserved recognition…but not for this season. Lindy Ruff had the best season of any coach in the NHL by far and maybe he’ll win the award next season if the Sabres DON’T win the Atlantic Division. The NHL Is ridiculous in so many ways, this is just another fly in the soup.

Congrats on the completely undeserved trophy. Lindy turned a perennial lottery team into an absolute wagon, in half a season. Beat the wheels off Tampa twice in route to winning the division over them. Tampa gets bounced first round. This is why people outside of the league shouldn't be voting for awards. Absolutely laughable 😂
